results.title: Top 8 Best Universities for Computer Science in France in 2026 | Study.eu
results.snippet:
France has many English-taught programmes at Bachelor’s, Master’s and Doctoral level. They rank highly for Computer Science on the CSRankings scoreboard - a metrics-based ranking of top computer science institutions around the world.

Here’s an overview of the top 8: [...] Public universities are the most common option. They offer a wide range of IT degrees (Bachelors and Masters), often at low tuition fees. These universities are accessible and focus on both theory and practical skills, with many programmes taught in English. [...] Thinking about a Bachelor’s or Master’s in IT?
